Booster T2

Flagship Embodied Development Platform

Smart. Powerful. Built to Perform.

Buy now

Real footage, not AI-generated

Powerful Compute, Built In.

Powered by industry-leading compute, Booster T2 completes the loop from perception and understanding to response. It doesn't just see the world. It understands it, and responds naturally and precisely across different scenarios.

Agile in Motion. Boundless in Capability.

Redefining how humanoid robots move and perceive, Booster T2 brings more natural motion, sharper environmental understanding, and a world of new possibilities.

Tough by Design. Built for Real Work.

Powerful payload capacity and a reliable hardware foundation give Booster T2 the confidence to take on complex tasks. From delicate manipulation to sustained operation, it performs with stability and stays ready at its best.

Flagship Platform. Unleash Your Creativity.

Powered by open platform capabilities, Booster T2 connects developers' boundless creativity with real-world execution. From algorithm innovation to scenario exploration, from virtual validation to real-world application, every idea can move quickly from concept to deployment.

Specifications

Education

Buy now

Height (standing): ~1.4 m (140 cm)

Weight: ~42 kg*

Degree of Freedom

Total DoFs: 31

DoFs per Leg: 6

DoFs per Arm: 7

Waist DoFs: 3

Head DoFs: 2

Actuators

Joint Output Bearing: Industrial-grade crossed roller bearings

Motor: High-speed internal-rotor PMSM

Maximum Dual-Arm Payload: 10 kg*

Max Peak Torque: 140 N·m

End Effector (Optional): standard, gripper, or dexterous hand.

Walking Speed: 3 m/s

Computing & Sensors

Computing Power: High-performance ARM processor, 375 TOPS AI computing power

Head Camera: Binocular camera

Waist Camera: Binocular camera

Wrist Camera / End-of-Arm Camera: Supported for gripper and dexterous-hand configurations

Audio Module: Microphone array + speaker

Body Interaction & Expansion

Buttons: 1 power button + 3 interaction buttons

Indicator: 1 RGB LED

Wireless Connectivity: Wi-Fi 6

Bluetooth: Bluetooth 5.2

Battery Rating: 48 V, 10 Ah

Battery Life: 2 hours of continuous walking

Charging Method: Magnetic charging port; supports charging while in use

External Ports: Power supply, USB Type-C® Locking Connector, Ethernet

LiDAR: Optional

Handheld Remote Controller: Available

Software & Technical Support

Large-Model Support: Supported

Firmware Upgrade: Supported

Secondary Development: Supported

Safety Protection: Soft and hard emergency stop

Voice Prompt: Low-battery warning and joint overtemperature warning

Warranty Information: 1 year; extended warranty available
